profile.headline: Software Engineer @ ZEPHYRx | Backend & Data Engineering in Healthcare Tech | Olympic Medalist | Public Speaker
profile.summary:
I build the backend systems and data infrastructure behind healthcare technology that helps people breathe easier and aids in clinical trials for new drugs.
 
At ZEPHYRx, I work across AWS serverless architecture - Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, EventBridge - designing and maintaining the pipelines that move clinical data from patients to providers. My work spans the full software lifecycle: architecting backend services, building and optimizing reporting systems, authoring data transfer specifications, and owning the delivery process end to end, including quality control, reconciliation, and direct communication with the clients who depend on that data being right.
 
Increasingly, my focus is data engineering leadership: designing pipelines that scale, automating the manual work that slows teams down, and making sure data moves reliably in an industry where accuracy isn't optional. I care about this work because healthcare data isn't abstract - it represents real patients and real outcomes.
 
Before engineering, I raced bicycles professionally and competed at the Olympic level. That background shaped how I work: comfort with high-stakes pressure, a long view on incremental improvement, and the understanding that individual performance only matters in service of the team. I also speak publicly on performance, discipline, and resilience.
 
Always happy to connect with people working at the intersection of healthcare and technology.
